scope: desktop and Android first model configuration
player_behavior: Desktop first launch opens the empty model editor instead of requiring an extra 添加模型档案 click.
Release defaults no longer contain a developer LAN address, a Huihui model name, or another machine-specific profile.
Selecting Ollama or LM Studio updates the protocol and local Base URL together; OpenAI-compatible deliberately requires an explicit Base URL.
Android applies the same provider presets and updates the Base URL immediately when the provider changes.
The settings and AI-world flows now reuse one typed desktop ModelProfileEditor with the same validation and accessibility behavior.
not_proven: The 3-minute first-run model setup target still needs macOS packaged WebView, Windows native, and Android physical-device timing.
Android physical-device IME behavior and TalkBack remain unrun because adb has no device.
